title: kbask ask lets an ask through to a session that ended cleanly, since SessionEnd releases its lease and intents and reach() then answers unknown
goal: kbask ask refuses, as ended, an ask to a session id that coord saw and whose lease SessionEnd released (no process, no live lease), naming the item it worked on when one is known, while an ask to a live session, to an unbound process's possible target, on Windows or to a served coord still goes through; a check plants a session that announced an intent and then ended cleanly and finds the ask refused, and one live target let through

run:
import json, os, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
try:
    os.environ["KB_COORD_STORE"] = os.path.join(d, "coord.db")
    import bl_peers, kbask, mon_sessions
    def coord(*a):
        return json.loads(subprocess.run([sys.executable, "_tools/coord.py", *a], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout)
    ended, live, never = ("00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001", "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002", "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003")
    token = coord("claim", "session/" + ended, "--ttl", "3600")["token"]
    coord("post", "--kind", "intent", "--field", "session=" + ended, "--field", "item=BG-zzzzzzzz")
    coord("release", "session/" + ended, "--token", token)
    mon_sessions.live_sessions = lambda root: [{"session": live, "label": "s-live", "role": "worker", "item": None}]
    root = kbask.clone_root()
    got = [bl_peers.reach(root, t, live)[:2] for t in (ended, live, never)]
    print(got)
    ok = got[0] == ("ended", ["BG-zzzzzzzz"]) and got[1][0] == "live" and got[2][0] == "unknown"
finally:
    shutil.rmtree(d, ignore_errors=True)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

options: Read the intent events the coord store keeps (read_events intent_at), only when the target has no live intent and no process
Keep a separate ended-session record in coord
gates.recommendation: Read the intent events the coord store keeps (read_events intent_at), only when the target has no live intent and no process
gates.reason: needs no new state, and the events outlive the released lease
